theater: 淮東沿海海州城與周邊鹽場

battle.name: 海州之戰
battle.theater: 淮東沿海海州城與周邊鹽場
battle.brief: 紹興三十二年春，金主完顏亮被弒後大軍北撤，宋軍乘勢向淮東反攻，江淮招討使張俊所部與楚州魏勝所部在海州城與鹽場一線，同滯留金兵爭奪城池、鹽運與海道。此役是金人南侵崩解後宋軍收復兩淮的前哨戰；卡面十字弩未見於本戰器械，實際立於城頭與鹽場寨舍的機械弩，是宋軍抵擋攻城器械與騎兵的支柱。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 海州之戰是金與南宋在淮東沿海的一次交鋒，戰場是海州城及其外圍的鹽場、海灘與通往楚州的道路。金方的指揮體系承自海陵王完顏亮南征時的編制：御駕親軍與中都留守司分掌兵權，樞密院擬定軍令，中路由完顏亮自將，東路自泗州、楚州方向向淮東推進，另有舟師自海道趨兩浙；前線部隊分隸各路統軍司與招討司，攻城器械、輜重車隊與舟船另有專司。金軍北撤之際，滯留在兩淮與沿海的部眾分散歸屬各路統軍，行動並不完全統一。宋方的指揮體系則是朝廷、宣撫司與州縣軍鎮三層：臨安朝廷以中書門下與樞密院分掌政事與軍令，戰起之後設督視江上軍務的差遣，由虞允文擔任，總攝沿江諸軍；淮東一線由江淮招討使張俊統兵，節制泗州、泰州、海州、楚州等地的守軍與鄉兵；楚州另有守臣魏勝與楚北鄉兵，沿海各州則有巡檢、寨兵與鹽場丁戶受當地州府調度。海州本身是淮東沿海的州治與鹽場所在，城有守軍，鹽戶編戶，兼負漕運與巡海之責，故城守與鹽場的存廢，直接牽動淮東軍資與海道舟師的往來。
countriesEn: The engagement at Haizhou was a clash between the Jin state and the Southern Song on the eastern Huai coast, fought around the city of Haizhou and the salt works, the mud flats and the road to Chuzhou that surrounded it. On the Jin side the chain of command was the one inherited from the southern campaign of the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang: the imperial main body and the Zhongdu garrison administration held the troops, the Privy Council drew up the orders, the central column was led by Wanyan Liang in person, the eastern column pushed forward out of Suzhou and Chuzhou toward eastern Huai, and a boat force came by the sea route toward the two Zhejiang. Field troops were distributed among the several regional commands and recruiting offices, while the siege engines, the trains of baggage and the boats had their own separate directorates. When the army began to withdraw north, the men left behind in eastern Huai and along the coast were scattered among these commands and did not act as one body. The Song chain of command ran in three layers: the Lin'an court, with the Secretariat and the Privy Council dividing the business of state from the business of war; a commission created once the fighting began, to supervise the river army, which was held by Yu Yunwen and brought the several armies on the river under one hand; and the garrisons of the prefectures and counties. In eastern Huai the line was held by Zhang Jun as recruiting commissioner of the Huai, commanding the garrisons of Suzhou, Taizhou, Haizhou and Chuzhou together with the armed villagers; the line of Chuzhou had its own defender in Wei Sheng and the armed villagers of northern Chu; and the coastal prefectures had their patrols, their village soldiers and their registered salt households under the local offices. Haizhou itself was the seat of a prefecture and the site of a salt work on the eastern Huai coast: it had a garrison, the salt households were on the registers, and it also bore the duty of carrying grain and of watching the sea. The state of its wall and of its salt works therefore bore directly on the war supply of eastern Huai and on the movement of the boats along the sea route.
people: 兩方面的關鍵人物各有分工。金方是海陵王完顏亮：紹興三十一年冬他自將大軍南侵，兵鋒直抵長江，采石受挫、瓜洲兵變之後被部將完顏元宜等人所弒，死時淮東與沿海的戰局仍未明朗；完顏元宜隨後迎金世宗完顏雍即位，並遣使與宋議和，隆興和議的端倪由此而起。宋方最可考的人物是江淮招討使張俊，他率兵自建康、鎮江一線向淮東推進，趁金軍北撤之際收復泗州、泰州、海州、楚州一帶，把前線重新推到淮水附近；其麾下統制官邵彥等分道出擊，負責沿海與鹽場方向的追擊與斷糧。楚州守臣魏勝是另一支不可忽視的力量，他以楚北鄉兵為骨幹，在楚州城外的神墩一帶屢挫敵鋒，並在海州方向與張俊策應，使金兵無法同時壓迫兩處。朝廷方面，中書舍人虞允文以督視江上軍務的差遣總攝沿江諸軍，采石大捷之後整頓軍紀、編次號令，成為宋軍在戰術層面的樞紐；而和議派與主戰派在朝廷爭執不休，張俊與魏勝的戰績既給了主戰派底氣，也讓朝廷在是否深入兩淮之間反覆動搖。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of the two sides had their separate parts to play. On the Jin side there was the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang: in the winter of the thirty-first year of Shaoxing he led the great army south himself, his spearhead reaching the Yangtze, and after the repulse at Caishi and the mutiny at Guazhou he was killed by his own officers, among them Wanyan Yuanyi, while the situation in eastern Huai and on the coast was still unsettled at the hour of his death. Wanyan Yuanyi then brought the Prince of Jin, Wanyan Yong, to the throne and sent envoys to negotiate with the Song, and the first outline of the Longxing settlement came out of that. The best documented figure on the Song side is Zhang Jun, recruiting commissioner of the Huai: he marched his men forward from Jiankang and Zhenjiang into eastern Huai and, taking advantage of the withdrawal of the Jin, recovered Suzhou, Taizhou, Haizhou and Chuzhou, pushing the front once more up to the Huai; the commanders of brigades under him, among them Shao Yan, were sent out in several directions to chase along the coast and in the salt district and to cut the enemy's supplies. Wei Sheng, the defender of Chuzhou, was another force that could not be ignored: with the armed villagers of northern Chu as his backbone he repeatedly threw the enemy back around the Shendun outside Chuzhou, and in the direction of Haizhou he acted in concert with Zhang Jun, so that the Jin could not press both points at once. At the court, Yu Yunwen, divisional secretary of the Secretariat, held the commission for supervising the river army and brought the several armies on the river under one hand; after the great victory at Caishi he reformed the discipline of the troops and set their order, and he became the hinge of the Song army in the tactical layer. At the same time the party of negotiation and the party of war argued endlessly at court, and the successes of Zhang Jun and Wei Sheng gave the war party its confidence while also making the court waver over whether to push deep into the Two Huai.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩是西元一一〇〇年前後成熟的歐洲弩，記載中並沒有出現在海州的城頭；出現在那裡的，是同一原理在中國的形態：蹶張弩、神臂弓與床子弩。三者的共同點是把拉力交給弩機的鋼弦與機件，扣機即發，射手只要校正望山就能精確射擊，單發力道足以穿透皮甲與薄盾；代價是裝填要踏蹶張弦或用鉤提弦，一次上弦往往要十數秒，野戰中一旦被逼近便難以再用。宋軍在海州把機械弩分置三處：城門與甕城之上居高臨下，封住通往州治的斜坡與街巷；城郊的鹽場團屋與村寨牆頭，用以壓制鹽灘上展開的騎兵；沿河沿海的船舫上，射擊接近的敵舟與搬運器械的工兵。與弩配合的是弓、長柄斧與大盾，防線靠壕溝、鹿角、拒馬與吊橋。金軍的裝備以騎兵為主，控弦之士先行，披重甲的步兵扛著撞車與雲梯逼近，另有石砲、飛石與火箭攻城，樓車則用來越過城頭。糧秣與運輸方面，海州鹽場的鹽是軍用大宗，宋軍以河船、鹽船自楚州、泗州運米沿海線轉輸，金軍靠騎兵就地取糧與隨軍輜重車隊，兩軍的補給都受制於海州一線的陸路與水道是否暢通。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is the European weapon that reached maturity around the year 1100, and it does not appear in the records of Haizhou; what appears there is the same principle in its Chinese form: the tiaozhang crossbow, the shenbin bow and the bed crossbow. What all three share is that the pull is handed over to the steel string and the mechanism of the lock, the shot goes off when the trigger is released, and the archer only has to correct the elevation by the sight to hit accurately, a single shot carrying enough force to pierce a leather coat and a light shield. The price is that the weapon must be cocked by stepping down on the stirrup or by lifting the string with a hook, and cocking it often takes a dozen seconds or more; once closed with in the open field it can hardly be used again. At Haizhou the Song set the mechanical crossbow in three places: on the gate and its barbican, looking down to seal the ramp and the streets that led to the seat of government; on the storehouses of the salt works and the walls of the village forts outside the city, to press the cavalry deployed on the salt flats; and on the boats along the river and the shore, from where they shot at the enemy craft that came close and at the workmen carrying the engines. Alongside the crossbow the Song had bows, long-handled axes and large shields, and the line was held by ditches, deer-antler obstacles, caltrops and drawbridges. The Jin equipment was cavalry in the main: bowmen to open the shooting, armoured infantry carrying battering rams and ladders up to the wall, with stone bombs, thrown stones and fire arrows for the siege and tower cars to reach the head of the wall. As to supply and transport, the salt of the Haizhou salt works was a great military commodity; the Song moved rice by river boat and salt boat from Chuzhou and Suzhou along the coastal line, while the Jin drew grain on the spot with their cavalry and carried it in trains of baggage wagons. The supply of both armies was thus bound up with whether the road and the waterway of the Haizhou line remained open.
tactics: 海州一線的打法，兩邊取向完全相反。金軍是典型的騎兵野戰加攻城：先以輕騎散開，遮蔽城郊道路，切斷宋軍自楚州方向來的糧道，再集中砲火與撞車攻擊城門與牆根，同時以雲梯、飛石在城牆各處同時施壓，企圖分散城頭守軍；鹽灘地勢平坦而鬆軟，重騎衝鋒受限，便改以步行攻城為主，把騎兵用於封鎖與追擊。宋軍的對策是守城待援與反擊策應並行：城頭以機械弩列陣，覆蓋城門、斜坡與牆外通道，攻方一旦把密集隊形擠到牆下，弩的單發破甲力道便可打穿攻城器械與披甲兵；守軍不與攻城者糾纏於城牆，而是以弓、長柄斧與火箭保持壓制，專打搬運石砲與雲梯的工兵；同時留出精銳由海門或水門出擊，襲擊金軍的砲陣與器械隊，目標是破壽其攻城器材而不是硬拼人數。另一端，楚州方向魏勝所部與張俊的援軍不斷沿路與鹽場推進，切斷金軍退往泗州的陸路，逼其不能長期滯留在城郊。兩軍爭奪的關鍵點，是城門前通往鹽場的斜坡、碼頭與東南面的出海口：控制這一帶，就控制海州城與淮東海岸之間的補給線。
tacticsEn: On the Haizhou line the two sides went about the work in opposite ways. The Jin followed the classic pattern of cavalry in the field combined with a siege: first light horse was spread out to screen the roads outside the city and to cut the supply route by which the Song drew grain from Chuzhou; then the fire of the stone bombs and the battering rams was concentrated on the gates and the foot of the wall, while ladders and thrown stones were applied at several points of the wall at the same time, the intention being to scatter the defenders on the wall-head. Because the salt flats were level and soft and heavy cavalry could not charge well, the siege was fought mainly on foot and the horse was used for blockade and pursuit. The Song answer was to hold the town and wait for the relieving force while striking out in concert: the mechanical crossbows were drawn up in line on the wall-head, covering the gates, the ramp and the approaches outside the wall, and once the attackers pressed their close formation against the foot of the wall the single heavy shot of a crossbow could pass through the siege engine and the armoured man who carried it. The defenders did not lock themselves in a struggle along the wall; with bows, long-handled axes and fire arrows they kept up a pressure aimed at the workmen hauling the stone bombs and the ladders, and at the same time they held picked troops in reserve to go out by the sea gate or the water gate and fall on the Jin bomb line and engine park, the object being to destroy the siege material rather than to match the enemy man for man. On the other front the men of Wei Sheng from Chuzhou and the relieving force of Zhang Jun kept pushing forward along the road and through the salt district, cutting the land route by which the Jin would fall back on Suzhou and so preventing them from staying outside the city for long. What the two sides fought over was the ramp from the gate down to the salt works, the wharf and the outlet to the sea on the south-east: hold that ground and you held the supply line between the city of Haizhou and the coast of eastern Huai.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。此役在紹興三十二年（一一六二年）春，時間在采石大捷（紹興三十一年十月）與金主完顏亮被弒（紹興三十一年十二月，公曆一一六二年一月）之後、隆興和議（隆興二年十一月）之前；本役的具體日子與雙方兵數，傳世記載零散，各家說法互有出入，無法給出確數。可以確定的編制事實有幾條：金人南征的總動員自紹興三十一年秋開始，宋人記為百萬之眾，顯係誇大，實際當在數十萬量級，分東、中、西三路與海道舟師四路推進；宋人收復淮東時，江淮招討使張俊所部與楚州守臣魏勝所部是兩支主力，記錄只說收復泗、泰、海、楚四州，兵數不載；海州城有甕城與角樓，牆面可容弩手分列，城外為鹽場開闊地，潮濕而鬆軟，不利重騎衝鋒；弩的一次上弦需時十數秒，一次齊射的箭矢消耗與長弓相當而穿透力更強。隆興二年十一月宋金訂約：宋稱臣、割唐鄧兩州、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬，兩國以淮水為界；海州之戰的得失，最後被壓縮進這紙和約的邊界線裡。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The engagement falls in the spring of the thirty-second year of Shaoxing, that is 1162, after the great victory at Caishi in the tenth month of the thirty-first year of Shaoxing and after the killing of the Jin ruler in the twelfth month of that year, which is January 1162 in the Gregorian calendar, and before the Longxing settlement of the eleventh month of the second year of Longxing. The exact day of the engagement and the numbers on both sides are scattered and thin in the transmitted record, the accounts differ one from another, and no exact figures can be given. A few facts about the order of battle can be settled: the general mobilisation of the Jin for the southern campaign began in the autumn of the thirty-first year of Shaoxing; the Song habitually wrote of a million men, which is plainly an exaggeration, the true figure being of the order of several hundred thousand, and the advance was made in three land columns with a fourth force coming by the sea. When the Song took eastern Huai back, the two main bodies were the men of Zhang Jun as recruiting commissioner of the Huai and the men of Wei Sheng who held Chuzhou; the records say only that Suzhou, Taizhou, Haizhou and Chuzhou were recovered, and give no numbers. The city of Haizhou had a barbican and corner towers, with wall-heads wide enough for the crossbowmen to stand in line, and outside the wall lay the open ground of the salt works, damp and soft, which was bad for a charge by heavy cavalry. Cocking a crossbow took a dozen seconds or more, and a salvo of them used about as many bolts as a salvo of bows while piercing far more. In the eleventh month of the second year of Longxing the Song and the Jin concluded a treaty: the Song should call itself a subject, Tang and Deng were to be ceded, and silver and silk were to be paid yearly to the value of two hundred and fifty thousand each, the frontier being the Huai. What was won and lost at Haizhou was in the end folded into that line on the map.
cause: 海州之戰的起因，是金軍北撤與宋軍反攻在淮東沿海撞在一起。紹興三十一年冬，金主完顏亮傾國南侵，采石兵敗、瓜洲弒主，金軍主力北還，但兩淮與沿海仍有大批部隊與器械滯留，鹽場、渡口與城鎮未及交還。金廷新主完顏雍既要收拾南征的殘局，也需要把鹽場收入與沿海航路拿在手中；對宋廷而言，隆興初年處境艱難，兩淮淪陷已近半載，淮南失地不復，軍食與漕運無從接續，朝野主戰之聲漸高，張俊、魏勝等地方大將也亟需一場勝利來鞏固淮東防線。於是宋軍沿淮東推進，指向泗州、泰州、海州與楚州；金人則為保住鹽場、維持退路而據城死守，兩軍在海州城外短兵相接。沿海的戰略意義尤其關鍵：海州是淮東鹽場所在，又扼海道舟師往來之口，控制它等於控制金人東路軍的糧道與撤退線，也等於把宋軍的防禦縱深推到淮水下游。
causeEn: The cause of the engagement at Haizhou was the collision, on the eastern Huai coast, of the Jin withdrawal with the Song counterattack. In the winter of the thirty-first year of Shaoxing the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang, had thrown the whole country into a southern campaign; after the defeat at Caishi and the killing of the ruler at Guazhou the main body of the Jin went north, yet great numbers of troops and engines were still held up in the Two Huai and along the coast, and the salt works, the ferry crossings and the walled towns had not been handed back. The new Jin ruler, Wanyan Yong, had both to settle the wreckage of the campaign and to keep the revenue of the salt works and the coastal shipping lane in Jin hands. For the Song court the situation in the early Longxing years was hard: the Two Huai had been lost for close to half a year, the lost ground north of the Huai had not been recovered, the army's food and the grain transport had no continuous source, the voices in favour of war grew louder in the capital, and commanders in the field such as Zhang Jun and Wei Sheng badly needed a victory to hold the eastern Huai line together. The Song army therefore pushed forward along eastern Huai toward Suzhou, Taizhou, Haizhou and Chuzhou, while the Jin, to keep the salt works and to hold open the line of retreat, stood fast in the towns; the two sides came to close quarters outside Haizhou. The coastal meaning of the ground was especially important: Haizhou held the salt works of eastern Huai and also sat on the mouth of the sea route by which the boat force moved, so that holding it was holding the supply line and the retreat line of the Jin eastern army, and was at the same time pushing the depth of the Song defence out to the lower Huai.
impact: 就當時而言，這場戰爭的影響主要落在兩個層面。軍事上，宋軍在淮東的反攻一度收復泗、泰、海、楚四州，把前線重新推到淮水附近，海州鹽場的生產與漕運短暫恢復，淮南軍食的接應多了一條沿海岸線的通道；金人則被逼退往淮北，其在沿海的舟師失去靠泊與補給的港灣，東路與海道之間的聯繫被切斷。但反攻的代價同樣明顯：宋軍深入兩淮，糧道拉長，前線與建康之間的距離逾千里，一遇金人反撲與秋雨泥濘便難以為繼，北伐最終在隆興元年下半年停步，隆興和議隨即以宋稱臣、割唐鄧、歲貢銀絹的代價換來相對均勢。技術上，這一役也再一次說明機械弩的戰場定位：在城牆上、在鹽場的固定射界裡面對密集隊形，弩的單發破甲與精準遠勝拉弓；但一旦需要離開城垣、在曠野上與騎兵比速度，弩的裝填時間便是致命弱點，弩手只能退守城內或隨大隊行軍。同一時期歐洲城堡攻防中弩手與配重投石車各司其事的格局，與此互為鏡像。
impactEn: For the time, the effect of this war fell under two headings. In the military line, the Song counterattack in eastern Huai recovered Suzhou, Taizhou, Haizhou and Chuzhou for a time and pushed the front back up to the Huai; the output of the Haizhou salt works and the grain traffic along it were briefly restored, and the war supply of the country south of the Huai gained a further channel running along the coast. The Jin, for their part, were driven back north of the Huai; their fleet along the coast lost the harbours where it could lie and take in stores, and the link between the eastern column and the sea route was cut. The cost of the counterattack was just as plain: the Song army had pushed deep into the Two Huai, the supply line was stretched, the distance from the front back to Jiankang ran to more than a thousand li, and a single Jin counterstroke or a wet autumn road could not be borne; the northern advance came to a stop in the second half of the first year of Longxing, and the Longxing settlement then bought a relative balance at the price of the Song calling itself a subject, ceding Tang and Deng, and paying tribute in silver and silk. In the technical line the engagement once more fixed the place of the mechanical crossbow in battle: on a wall, in the fixed field of fire of a salt work, against a close formation, the single armour-piercing and accurate shot of a crossbow was far better than a drawn bow; but the moment the shooter had to leave the wall and match the speed of cavalry in the open, the cocking time became a fatal weakness, and the crossbowman could only fall back inside the walls or march with the main body. The pattern in the castle sieges of contemporary Europe, where the crossbowmen and the counterweight trebuchets each had their own part, is the mirror image of this.
result: 結果上，經過城郊與鹽場一帶的反覆爭奪，海州一度易手，其後仍回到南宋手中，由張俊所部與州軍分守，並恢復鹽場生產。失去海州之後，金人在淮東的殘部失去了最後一個像樣的據點與港口，全軍北撤的日程再無延宕；宋軍也沒有能力再往北推進，兩淮的實際控制線最後落到淮水一線，以隆興二年十一月的和約作為收束。關於此役本身的細節，傳世記載有限，但可以確定的有幾點：它發生在紹興三十二年、即一一六二年的淮東沿海；交戰雙方是金與南宋，宋方主力是江淮招討使張俊所部與楚州魏勝所部；爭奪的標的是海州城、鹽場與沿海航道；它發生在完顏亮被弒、金軍北撤而宋軍乘勢反攻的短暫窗口之中；它的結果，與其說是一場徹底的勝利，不如說是把戰線固定下來的一次力量校準，而卡面那件十字弩所代表的機械弩，也在這樣的城垣攻防中再一次確定了自己的位置。
resultEn: As to the outcome, after repeated fighting around the outskirts of the city and over the salt works, Haizhou changed hands for a time but at last came back to the Southern Song, was held in part by the men of Zhang Jun and in part by the prefectural troops, and the salt works began to produce again. Having lost Haizhou, the remnants of the Jin in eastern Huai were without their last proper base and their last port, and the schedule of the general withdrawal north could be delayed no further. The Song in turn had no strength to press further north, the line of actual control in the Two Huai came to rest on the Huai, and the affair was closed by the settlement of the eleventh month of the second year of Longxing. On the details of the engagement itself the transmitted record is limited, but a few things can be settled: it took place on the eastern Huai coast in the thirty-second year of Shaoxing, that is 1162; the two sides were the Jin and the Southern Song, the main Song strength being the men of Zhang Jun as recruiting commissioner of the Huai together with those of Wei Sheng from Chuzhou; what was fought over was the city of Haizhou, the salt works and the coastal shipping lane; it took place in the short window between the killing of Wanyan Liang, the withdrawal of the Jin and the Song counterattack that followed; and its result was less a complete victory than a calibration of forces that fixed the line where it stood. The mechanical crossbow represented by the weapon on the card, for its part, once more fixed its own place in such fighting around the walls of a city.
